decisions.statement: A relative path is spelled as the root package name joined to the path from the checkout root.
Every body under the folder named is read.
A body that is not TypeScript is passed over.
A relative path landing on no body the world holds is left as it is.
A relative path climbing above the checkout root is left as it is.
A specifier naming a package is left as it is.
A string naming no module is left as it is.
A folder holding no TypeScript is refused.
A folder whose bodies name no relative path is refused.

definition: every relative path a folder's bodies name spelled from the checkout root instead
